baseline: Strict-valid audited union197; proposal196 preserves selected177 plus19 strict-valid historical anchor additions.
include_conditions: Exact requested version returned; current accession unchanged; assembly status current; annotated NCBI RefSeq GCF source.
Unique ranked GENUS and named SPECIES, Datasets/E-utilities genus/species agreement and no Enterococcus ancestry.
Ten intended operational groups; Streptococcus restricted to species taxID1308, not arbitrary Streptococcus species.
Complete Genome, Chromosome or Scaffold; reported contigs<=100, CheckM completeness>=95%, contamination<=5%, all three required.
Accession belongs to the audited197 union.
quality_boundary: NCBI-reported metadata predicates only; no locally executed CheckM, sequence validation, ANI or genetic redundancy analysis.
coverage_rationale: Preserve110 ranked named species and24 source-derived historical anchors with inclusive strain coverage. Not globally optimal and not necessary merely for species coverage;162 is a smaller sensitivity alternative.
legacy_exception: Hold GCF_000056065.1 for missing contamination; inherited exception is not silently accepted.
historical_authority: This is an explicitly revised proposal policy, not a rewrite of historical177/150 authority. Their originals and history remain immutable.
historical_query_limitations: Current metadata supports annotated RefSeq and named species, but historical MAG/atypical/multi-isolate query exclusion is not independently re-executed or fully established.
human_gate: Only subsequent explicit HUMAN approval may authorize sequence analysis. Parent-agent review is not approval.
